property_summary: For any input address newRoundImplementation, the reference contract accepts a non-zero address (does not revert) and sets roundImplementation to that address; the mutant instead only accepts the zero address and will reject non-zero addresses (or set the slot to zero), so there exists an input (any non-zero address) that makes their post-state differ.
change_summary: Replace the require that newRoundImplementation is non-zero with a require that it IS zero, causing updateRoundImplementation to only accept the zero address and set roundImplementation to address(0).
